dedupe_keys.name: pronto heterogeneous multiphase flow benchmark dataset

description: The PRONTO benchmark contains heterogeneous observations from an industrial-scale multiphase-flow facility. Stief, Tan, Cao and Ottewill publish it as an output of the H2020 PRONTO project to support fault diagnosis and data fusion. Its documented contents include process measurements, alarm records, high-frequency ultrasonic flow and pressure signals, an operation log and video. Experiments cover different operating conditions with and without deliberately induced faults. Spatial coverage is one experimental facility; exact calendar bounds and channel-specific sampling frequencies are not stated in the inspected landing-page metadata. The canonical Zenodo release provides a roughly 1.7 GB ZIP archive, technical documentation and a small README, free under CC BY 4.0. The archive was not downloaded, so individual file schemas and alignment between modalities remain unchecked. Experimental faults should not be treated as population frequencies of failures in operating plants. Simulation uses include validating process monitoring, fault-detection algorithms and sensor fusion. The benchmark complements data-tennessee-eastman-process-anomaly-detection with physical-facility multimodal measurements, not only a simulated process benchmark.
